title: introduce-contextual-log-diff-and-token-health-aggregator-with-dashboard
author: Riley Chen
description:
Motivation: Long-tail token spikes and correlated latency bursts keep generating noisy paging signals. Root-causing these events often requires manually joining traces, raw logs, and token-attribution metrics. This PR introduces two complementary observability primitives: (1) a lightweight token-health aggregator that computes per-invocation token statistics and a small API to list top callsites by token anomaly score; (2) a contextual log-diffing helper that surfaces the delta between a sampled anomalous invocation and its recent baseline cohort (same route, similar prompt shape). We also add an opinionated Grafana dashboard (token-health) and a tuned composite alert that couples burn-rate and per-request token-latency to reduce false positives.

What this changes (high level): added an in-service aggregator that emits low-cardinality token-health metrics (median token-per-stage, kv-cache-miss-rate, token-entropy, warmup-latency), trace enrichment to attach token counts and per-stage timings to root spans, a small REST endpoint for the SRE console to query top offenders, a contextual log diff tool that fetches baseline logs and highlights inserted/removed lines, updated alerting rules and dashboards, and a short docs + quickstart.

Checklist: - [x] Token-health aggregator implementation and unit tests - [x] Trace span enrichment and minor schema bump (+compatibility guards) - [x] Grafana dashboard JSON + panels for token health and anomaly inspector - [x] Alertmanager rules: composite burnrate+latency threshold with quiet-window - [x] Python SDK convenience helper for querying top offenders - [x] Docs and runbook snippet for triage flow - [x] CI green (lint/unit/integration) on final merge

Backwards compatibility notes: trace enrichment adds optional attributes (token_count, token_stage_ms) guarded behind a feature flag defaulted on for observability-by-default customers and off for older private installs. Metrics emitted are intentionally aggregated to tenant-level and route-level only to avoid explosion of high-cardinality tags.

release_notes: Added token-health observability surface: new Grafana dashboard 'Token Health', composite alert that couples burn-rate and per-request token-latency, span enrichment with token_count/stage timings (feature-flagged), a token-health aggregator service and a console API to surface top offending callsites. See docs/observability/token-health.md for triage steps and SDK quickstart.
notes_for_oncall: If alert fires, use token-health dashboard to inspect median token-per-stage and kv-cache-miss-rate. Use the 'anomaly inspector' panel to open the contextual log-diff view for the offending invocation; the top-offender API will list likely callsites. Quiet-window annotation indicates how long alert suppression will persist for correlated bursts.
